items.statement: Each of the six labeled neutral-singlet TPAAN cases is computed with state identity and convergence evidence, and S1 and T1 are evaluated on the geometry/state appropriate to the requested transition.
items.expected: Six case-specific records identify molecule, solvent, charge/multiplicity, geometry/state, convergence, and transition identity; failures are explicit.

items.statement: The six relaxed S1->S0 energies reproduce the SI Table S1 values for OMe, CHO, and H in hexane and chloroform.
items.expected: OMe: 2.16 eV hexane and 2.11 eV chloroform; CHO: 2.18 and 2.14 eV; H: 2.20 and 2.16 eV, within the stated numeric tolerance.

items.statement: The six S0-geometry S0->T1 energies remain near 1.27-1.28 eV with little solvent dependence.
items.expected: OMe 1.27/1.27 eV, CHO 1.27/1.28 eV, H 1.27/1.27 eV for hexane/chloroform, within tolerance; the maximum solvent spread is small.

items.statement: The low-lying bright singlet transitions are reported as predominantly H->L, while the triplet transition has zero oscillator strength when spin-orbit coupling is omitted.
items.expected: Submitted state/transition diagnostics are consistent with dominant H->L-like S1 character and a dark S0->T1 transition, or justify an equivalent state assignment.
